description: This file defines the AmplifyUIBuilderClient class, a client for interacting with the AWS Amplify UI Builder service. It includes method annotations for various operations like creating, deleting, exporting, and updating components, forms, themes, and other resources related to AWS Amplify UI Builder.

classes.name: AmplifyUIBuilderClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Amplify UI Builder service. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for various API operations.
